data.name: River Flow
data.description: As a free action while you are underwater, you can negate the penalties you take for making bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing melee attacks underwater. You can use this ability %1 rounds per day. The rounds do not have to be used consecutively.|max(1,1+CHA)
